result.description: Compact handheld document scanner designed for receipts, notebooks, and travel paperwork. The Nimbus Quill 7 uses a CIS sensor with 600 dpi optical resolution, USB-C connectivity, and onboard microSD capture for quick off-grid archiving. Lightweight polycarbonate housing and one-touch scan control make it suitable for mobile filing and home office use.
result.title: Nimbus Quill 7 Portable Scanner
result.title_description: Handheld document scanner with USB-C and microSD storage
